newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 50,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 50,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 50,000 tonnes of hard durum amber wheat for sale, a company spokesman said on Friday.
March 25 was the final date for receiving bids and results would be announced on March 26.
The wheat, from the 1996 crop, would be ready for shipment in May. Partial offers would be accepted and partial shipment would be allowed, the official said.
The GECPT issued a tender on March 11 for the sale of 40,000 tonnes but no results were announced. Traders said this might mean the tender was cancelled.
